questions.question: Which of the following is NOT included in the Blue Economy 2.0 scheme?
Which team won the 3rd edition of Women’s Premier League in 2025?
The famous valleys of Kashmir, Kangra and Kullu are located in which of the following ranges of the Himalayas?
Which was the first State to release the Semiconductor Policy 2022-27?
Which of the following innovations could help conserve freshwater by improving agricultural efficiency and reducing wastage?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (IoT- and data-driven precision farming) है।

questions.question: In the expenditure method of computing the national income, which of the following items will NOT be included?
options: Government purchases of goods and services
Expenditure on purchase second hand goods
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Expenditure on purchase second hand goods) है।

questions.question: भारतीय संविधान के अनुसार, भारत के प्रत्येक नागरिक का, जो माता-पिता या संरक्षक है, यह कर्तव्य होगा कि वह छह से _____ वर्ष की आयु के बीच के अपने बच्चे या प्रतिपाल्य, जैसा भी मामला हो, को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करे।
निम्नलिखित में से किस इतिवृत्त में उल्लेख है कि चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य क्षत्रिय वंश से संबंधित थे जिसे मोरिया के नाम से जाना जाता था?
Kerala film industry, that produces films in Malayalam, is nick-named _________.
In the year 2023, the movie 'The Elephant Whisperers' got the Oscar Award in the category of ________________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Best Documentary (Short Film)) है।

questions.question: जिला परिषद के कार्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन गलत है?
options: यह विभिन्न पंचायत समितियों के कार्यों का समन्वय करता है।
यह राज्य द्वारा आवंटित धन को सीधे ग्राम पंचायतों को वितरित करता है।
यह जिले में विकास गतिविधियों के संबंध में राज्य सरकार को सलाह देता है।
यह पंचायत समितियों के बजट की जांच और अनुमोदन करता है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (यह राज्य द्वारा आवंटित धन को सीधे ग्राम पंचायतों को वितरित करता है।) है।

questions.question: The Law of Diminishing Marginal Product states that:
options: the marginal product increases as total product decreases
the total product increases as marginal product decreases
the marginal product decreases as the quantity of variable input increases
the total product decreases as the quantity of fixed input increases
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (the marginal product decreases as the quantity of variable input increases) है।

questions.question: Which of the following committees are associated with Panchayati Raj in India?I. Balwant Rai MehtaII. GVK RaoIII. Ashok MehtaIV. Gadgil
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (I, II, III and IV) है।

questions.question: Which state/union territory of India has the highest percentage of Sikh population as per the 2011 census?
The inscription on the Vaishali Pillar of Ashoka is presently located in which of the following states of India?
Which team won the Khelo Creators League 2025 trophy?
In which state of India was the 12th Divya Kala Mela organised from 29 December 2023 to 7 January 2024?

With which of the following institutes did the Indian Register of Shipping (IRS) Mumbai sign an MOU on advancing maritime safety through the development of a ship trajectory prediction tool in July 2024?
What is the primary function of the ozone layer in the Earth’s atmosphere?
options: To absorb harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun
To produce and supply oxygen essential for all living organisms
To trap carbon dioxide and help in regulating the temperature
To reflect sunlight effectively and assist in causing rainfall
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (To absorb harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun) है।
